attributes.android:text: Fast proxy servers combined with affordability. Ideal solution for individuals. A reliable and secure way to access the internet anonymously.

Rethink DNS + Firewall are anti-surveillance tools first and foremost: It is absolutely against our ethos, then, to track users of our apps and services, or sell any information whatsoever to any third-party in any form, pseudo-anonymized, de-anonymized, anonymized, aggregated, or otherwise. We do not collect, sell, license, share any data (personally identifiable or otherwise) from the Rethink DNS + Firewall Android app. The code is open source so you may inspect it yourself or deploy to your servers. 
Personally identifiable information: Any data that can be traced back to the user including (but not limited to) a combination of IP addresses, name, device-id, advertisement-id, and location. 

 Non personally identifiable information: Aggregrated (summarized) data and anonymized data scrubbed off any personally identifiable information. 
Collect: Data stored by Rethink. 
Sell: Data sold to third parties. 
License: Restricted access to data collected by Rethink to third parties. 
Share: Data shared with third parties. 
Aggregate: Data combined with other data to form a summary of information. 
Anonymize: Data scrubbed off any personally identifiable information. 
De-anonymize: Data scrubbed off any personally identifiable information. 
Share: Permanent access to data collected by Rethink to third parties. 

We do not collect, sell, license, share any data (personally identifiable or otherwise) from the Rethink DNS + Firewall Android app. The code is open source so you may inspect it yourself or deploy to your servers.

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: w600dp logs is 0dp height, top below throughput, bottom constrained to fhs_row2_bottom_barrier over proxy/apps; outer gutters remain 2dp/8dp/10dp and 12dp vertical separation.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: HomeContent uses independent .58/.42 Column heights. LogsCard has content-driven height and cannot share the proxy/apps bottom boundary. This is separate from the already-restored compat gutters.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore the cross-column measurement relationship in native Compose, and assert logs/apps outer bottom bounds for normal/long/hidden-content states. Preserve existing navigation-clearance and gutter fixes.
reviewed_findings.title: Wide Home logs card no longer reaches the shared bottom barrier

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: The wide layout puts count/title above an aligned Flow with maxElementsWrap=2, horizontal gap 12dp and vertical gap 6dp. ConstraintFlow owns blocked, isolated, bypassed, excluded order. Phone and wide have separate geometry.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: AppsCard shares one FlowRow for both qualifiers and nests two Columns in a Row; count/title and metrics may become siblings on one row, and row alignment/wrap is not the original 2×2 flow.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Implement explicit phone and wide grid grouping from the two XML contracts. Assert row/column placement, wrap and reading order with long translated metrics.
reviewed_findings.title: Home apps metric grid and qualifier-specific grouping collapsed

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Protection bar, firewall rules card and logs pager have fixed XML dimensions (40dp, wide rules 80dp, pager 168dp wide/190dp phone); card clearance consumes part of outer card constraints. NestedScrollView fillViewport=true is also explicit.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: ProtectionRow, RulesCard and NativePager use heightIn(min=...), while parent wrapping and padding order differ. Rules minimum is applied inside HomeCard after outside clearance, not to the original outer card. Scrollable Column does not explicitly reproduce fillViewport.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Record outer allocated height versus visible surface versus content minimum for each state, then match default-font geometry without accidental double insets. Decide/validate large-text growth explicitly rather than call min-height equivalent to fixed height.
reviewed_findings.title: Home fixed heights are now minimums with different padding constraints

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Default Widget.Rethink.MaterialCardView has 2dp elevation and compat padding; Frost has zero elevation; rules explicitly zero.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: HomeCard uses calculated padding then clip/background/border. It does not draw a shadow or an elevated Surface/Card. The restored gap is not the full elevation treatment.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Preserve theme-dependent shadow rendering as well as measured outside clearance. Avoid duplicating compat padding or adding shadows to zero-elevation rules/Frost.
reviewed_findings.title: Home card elevation space restored but shadow is not rendered

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Source labels use letterSpacing (.02/.05), maxLines/ellipsize and several uniform autosize ranges (rules 8–12sp; proxy labels 6–8sp). Home text size/color/alpha are not the complete contract.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: HomeText accepts size/color/monospace/allCaps but no letterSpacing, maxLines, ellipsize or source font weight; RulesCard and proxy labels use unbounded Text with fixed sizes.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Carry actual baseline text contracts into presentation-only text rendering, retaining default-font alignment and source-specific overflow. Add narrow/RTL/large-font fixtures for rules, proxy legend and apps labels.
reviewed_findings.title: Home typography loses source tracking, truncation and autosize

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: MaterialCardView inherits Widget.Rethink.MaterialCardView/Frost, including cardUseCompatPadding=true; explicit per-card radius/stroke/content padding and margins apply on top.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: SettingsCard resolves fill/radius/elevation only, then draws a Compose Card to full allocated bounds. It does not resolve compat padding, prevent-corner-overlap, max elevation, card stroke or explicit Android foreground.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Create a source-style-aware native card primitive and map each call to its actual style plus per-card overrides. Reconcile outer clearance separately from content padding, including zero-elevation Frost.
reviewed_findings.title: Settings/DNS cards still omit inherited compat-padding geometry

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: WireGuard cards and their children have individually specified radii, margins, padding and constrained subrows; uptime/rx-tx are peers in a RelativeLayout in interface rows.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: WgCard always creates an inner Column with 16dp padding and 8dp spacing and no compat padding. WgRows stacks uptime and rx-tx separately instead of their original shared row. WgAppRow omits its source icon-container geometry.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Use per-card contracts rather than one content-padding default. Restore explicit subrow grouping, hidden-child spacing and modifier order for each WireGuard layout.
reviewed_findings.title: WireGuard card wrapper flattens per-layout padding and row grouping

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: These XML controls specify CustomWidget.Material3.CompoundButton.MaterialSwitch, whose CustomCompoundButtonSwitch overlay overrides colorSurface/colorOnSurface/colorControlActivated and secondary colors; checked/unchecked/disabled states matter.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: Their native calls use raw Switch defaults without the source overlay. RethinkTheme global colors do not apply an individual widget materialThemeOverlay.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Route through a native switch renderer that resolves the particular XML style/overlay and its state colors/dimensions. Existing wgSwitchColors is useful partial infrastructure but not a blanket equivalence exemption.
reviewed_findings.title: Raw switches bypass the original theme overlays

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Baseline mixes MaterialRadioButton, AppCompatRadioButton and RadioButton, sometimes with explicit CustomCompoundButtonSwitch overlay, tint or padding. These are not a single global Material3 radio style.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: Native renderers mostly use RadioButton defaults. AntiCensorshipRow does not resolve the explicit overlay applied to all nine XML radios.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Resolve source widget defaults/overlays and checked/unchecked/disabled states per family. Preserve selection group semantics and avoid duplicate targets when both row and control are clickable.
reviewed_findings.title: Radio controls have unreviewed source-style/default differences

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Baseline uses AppCompatSeekBar for several settings and a separately styled Slider for sponsorship; thumb/track/ticks/min-height arise from different widget defaults.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: Advanced/Network sources use generic Compose Slider, including its visual track/thumb/tick system, without source style/drawable resolution; callback preservation does not preserve visual form.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Map each source slider type/attributes to an explicit native visual contract. Resolve external widget defaults in independent reference fixtures before deleting XML.
reviewed_findings.title: SeekBar/Slider replacement does not preserve the source widget appearance

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Server-order progress is 3dp, square-cornered, accentGood on chipBgColorPositive. Server-loading timeout is 3dp with 4dp corners. Other XML progress nodes retain per-instance tints and thickness.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: HistoryScreen and WgProgress use default LinearProgressIndicator parameters; server-loading does not set source track corner/gap/stop behavior. Current Compose defaults are not verified against original MDC defaults.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Map determinate/indeterminate progress per original node, including track, thickness, corner shape, gap/stop decorations, insets and accessible range.
reviewed_findings.title: Progress defaults replace explicit source track/color contracts

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Summary title 14sp bold single-line ellipsis; subtitle 11sp single-line ellipsis with 2dp top margin; count 12sp with .85 alpha; icon22dp in 40dp frame.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: StatisticsRow uses bodySmall (12sp) for subtitle and bodyMedium (14sp) for count; text has no maxLines/ellipsis; subtitle loses 2dp top margin. WgStatsRow also reorders data/name and has its own incompatible geometry.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Preserve distinct summary/variant row contracts. Reintroduce exact sizes, line limits and baseline margins; do not use the same generic row for layouts with different metrics.
reviewed_findings.title: StatisticsRow no longer matches the source summary row text contract

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: RPN app row has horizontal20dp/vertical7dp padding, 32dp icon, 14sp normal title, 11sp .7-alpha metadata and 13sp sans-serif-medium total; line limits are one.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: RpnStatsBottomSheet uses StatisticsRow with 16dp/8dp padding, 22dp icon in 40dp frame, bold title, bodySmall metadata and bodyMedium total. This is a different layout contract.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Give RPN app statistics its own source-backed row variant and check long-name/large-font ellipsis rather than inherit summary-row defaults.
reviewed_findings.title: RPN statistics app row is incorrectly collapsed into StatisticsRow

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Domain row is minHeight40dp; padding start52/end46/top4/bottom4; 12sp primaryLightColorText single-line middle ellipsis; count minWidth32dp with 8dp start margin.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: BlocklistAppsAdapter.GroupAt uses start54/end16/top8/bottom8, raw Text with no explicit 12sp/color/single-line/middle ellipsis/min count width. App headers also inherit generic StatisticsRow.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore app and expanded-domain variants separately, including row minimum, count alignment and middle-ellipsis behavior.
reviewed_findings.title: Expanded blocklist-domain row loses geometry, type and overflow

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: History rows are horizontal icon-frame plus text stack within a shared parent list; payment icon24dp in 44dp neutral circle, server icon24dp in 32dp positive circle; per-node order/margins/dividers differ.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: HistoryRowContent renders a vertical Column with 28dp icon then all content, loses circle backgrounds and timestamp timer drawable, reorders badge/title/timestamp content and uses a generic divider. HistoryScreen wraps each item in an individual Card.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore each row hierarchy and the shared parent-card/list grouping. Preserve control restoration inside it. tv_purchase_token is always GONE in baseline adapter; its non-rendering is not a missing-visible-content bug.
reviewed_findings.title: Purchase/history grouping and icon backgrounds changed

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Server-row include is a 16dp-corner card with icon36dp, text120×14/70×10 separated by6dp, trailing20dp square and explicit margins. Subscription/card skeletons have their own detailed arrangements.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: History uses PurchaseShimmer with four 120dp 2×2 blocks; RpnShimmer uses fractional-width lines. A running shimmer animation alone does not preserve source placeholder composition.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Create native source-specific skeleton variants; keep each include fanout and shimmer timing/direction/alpha. Cover loading before final data, including stopped shimmer state.
reviewed_findings.title: Loading skeleton layouts replaced by generic shapes

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: bg_vpn_server_add_tile uses 1dp border with dashWidth6dp/dashGap4dp and radius16dp; label11sp sans-serif-medium .02em tracking, one line. Tile minHeight80dp excludes outer margin6dp.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: RpnAddServerTile uses a solid border and plain Text; heightIn(80dp) precedes padding6dp, so margin consumes minimum allocation rather than remaining outside it.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Paint the actual dashed drawable/shape in Compose and restore label contract and outer-margin/min-height relationship.
reviewed_findings.title: Add-server tile lost its dashed stroke and label typography

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Country flag12sp with includeFontPadding=false; server count11sp; code has mini size/bold/tracking. Header is11sp bold sans-serif-medium, .1em tracking, start/end4dp top14/bottom4dp.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: CountryServerAdapter.Country draws flag26sp and code10sp; headers use labelSmall with start8/bottom8 and omit source weight/family/tracking. Country card/title/count and group layouts share generic Text defaults.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore exact country/header/group variants and source drawable/background geometry. Keep the already-restored favourite artwork and selection callbacks.

source_evidence.excerpt: if (letter != previous) Text(letter, Modifier.padding(start = 8.dp, top = 14.dp, bottom = 8.dp)

reviewed_findings.title: Country selector and alphabet headers changed text metrics

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Source badge uses rectangle_border_background: radius16dp, .75dp border; list badges have minWidth25dp/padding5dp; detail badges are fixed32×32 with bold text.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: RuleStatusBadge uses MaterialTheme.shapes.small, no border, horizontal8/vertical4 padding and no 32dp detail variant or bold weight.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Use source-specific list/detail badge variants with original drawable, min/fixed constraints and dynamic tint state. A badge is not covered merely because buttons/chips are restored.

source_evidence.excerpt: Surface(color = bg, contentColor = fg, shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.small)

reviewed_findings.title: Rule status badges are generic filled surfaces instead of framed source badges

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Editor title14sp plus XML10dp padding, description11sp and specified margins; error12sp with margin10dp/padding5dp. Dialog window background/theme is separate from layout content.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: RuleDialog defaults title20sp/titleLarge, padding20dp and spacedBy10dp; RuleEditor body/error texts use generic inherited sizing instead of XML sizes/paddings. Original fields/buttons do not restore surrounding text.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Map dialog content and window separately; preserve original title/body/error typography and spacing. Independently compare actual themed window shape rather than assume extraLarge is correct.
reviewed_findings.title: Rule editor title/body/error geometry still uses generic dialog text

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Rows use CardView with compat padding; allowed icon28dp within44dp circular frame; name one-line marquee and row child constraints; source content vertical padding10dp.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: BubbleRow uses generic Material3 Card, icon32dp with no44dp frame, content padding12dp and unbounded name text. Large-font button reflow is deliberate current behavior but is not baseline equivalence.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore original card/icon/name constraints while preserving accessible actions. Document any authorized large-font alternate layout independently; default-font equality is still required.
reviewed_findings.title: Bubble app rows lose source icon frame and name marquee

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Examples: app include label sans-serif-medium16sp/.01em; description sans-serif12sp/.02em; RPN bypass heading sans-serif-medium18sp; SSID dialog title .01em.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: WgText handles color/size/maxLines/bold/italic but has no fontFamily/letterSpacing/textAppearance/line-height input. Shared renderer cannot reproduce those properties solely from IDs.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Extend source-specific text style metadata and route every affected TextView to it, resolving textAppearance before explicit overrides. Keep state and callback code untouched.
reviewed_findings.title: WireGuard text helper cannot carry several explicit text properties

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Status12sp, hint10sp, title17sp bold sans-serif-medium; explicit margins and minLines2.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: RpnProgressContent status has no fontSize (inherits bodyLarge), hint uses bodySmall (12sp), and title does not resolve sans-serif-medium. Most geometry is present but typography differs.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Use explicit source text style values for these nodes and retain independent progress decoration verification.
reviewed_findings.title: RPN progress dialog status/hint text grew from original sizes

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Both TabLayouts explicitly use @style/TabbedLayoutDefault; selected text, unselected text, indicator/background, ripple and label appearance are part of that style.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: CustomRulesActivity and NetworkLogsActivity call raw TabRow/Tab. The style resource is not consumed by their native tab components.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Map all TabbedLayoutDefault properties to a shared source-backed native tab strip and preserve tab height/selection/scrolling/indicator in both hosts.
reviewed_findings.title: Tabbed hosts do not resolve TabbedLayoutDefault

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Baseline contains 20 AppCompatCheckBox, 8 MaterialCheckBox and multiple explicit tints, minimum sizes and widget theme choices; source selection semantics and duplicate row/control targets also differ.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: Current native implementations include CheckboxDefaults/default Checkbox and some custom tint helpers. The previous 213-variant control census covered button/chip/field/icon families, not full checkbox parity.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Account for every checkbox node and its actual native invocation; compare source-resolved checked/unchecked/indeterminate/disabled colors, shape/size and semantic grouping. Do not broadly replace the tint-preserving cases.
reviewed_findings.title: Checkbox/selection visuals need a separate source-style census

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: XML layout_height=fixed, minHeight, style/chipMinHeight, inset and parent constraints have distinct precedence. Some source chips are compact and some opt out of minimum touch target.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: OriginalControl stores fixed visualHeight but renders it with heightIn(min=look.height); interactive Box adds minimumInteractiveComponentSize and propagation. The surrounding layout can therefore allocate/grow differently even when colors and radius are correct.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Keep all existing per-instance style keys. Test outer/touch/visual/content bounds independently at default and large fonts; resolve fixed/min/parent precedence and source touch-target rules before accepting a layout.
reviewed_findings.title: Fixed visual size versus minimum/touch size must be proven for restored controls

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Each layout supplies distinct line limits, ellipsis, font family, source sizes and count/flag/progress alignment. Country is not identical to domain/IP.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: AppConnectionRow flattens three types into shared14sp title/12sp subtitle/16sp count; Text does not apply node textStyle/maxLines/ellipsize. Generic count/font and row padding replace original attrs.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Make per-layout row variants or pass complete source contracts; preserve current progress explicit colors and source-specific icon/flag states.
reviewed_findings.title: App connection rows omit source line/weight/font distinctions

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: list_item_endpoint endpoint_flag_text has minWidth32dp/minHeight32dp, centered25sp text, marginEnd5dp; endpoint rows also inherit card compat styling.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: DnsEndpointRow flag is raw Text with end5dp and25sp size, without the source minimum frame or centered text. Protocol layouts need separate attribute comparison rather than a generic endpoint equivalence assumption.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Preserve flag slot constraints per protocol variant and independently resolve card/tint/selection artwork contracts.
reviewed_findings.title: Endpoint flag minimum frame was lost

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Both buttons use toggleButtonStyle, minWidth125dp and cornerRadius16dp within a single-selection MaterialButtonToggleGroup; source style adds accent stroke and state fill/text.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: DnsRecordTypesContent draws two independent Surface/Text controls, with no source stroke/minWidth/fused inner-corner semantics. Keys already exist in OriginalControlCatalog but are unused by these nodes.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Use exact existing catalog variants with segmentIndex/count, original dynamic tints, selection callbacks and test tags. Extend integration guard to catch manually painted source controls.
reviewed_findings.title: DNS record-mode controls bypass their existing original-control catalog

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Description/selected/empty text12sp, item name14sp bold, item URL12sp with2dp top margin; heading uses explicit TitleSmall.Emphasized style.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: BlockFreeDnsContent uses bodyMedium14sp for description and default Text for selected/empty/name/URL (bodyLarge16sp), and URL top10dp. Cards are manually flattened surfaces.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Retain restored filter/type-chip keys, but restore explicit surrounding text styles and URL margin; map the original MaterialCard shapes/elevation/insets separately.
reviewed_findings.title: Block Free DNS surrounding text and URL spacing differ

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Filter headings14sp secondaryTextColor with original margin/padding; handle60×3dp border color and10dp/20dp vertical margins.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: FirewallFilterContent uses16sp default-color headings, a generic HorizontalDivider color and shared20dp/spacedBy10dp arrangement. BlocklistFilterScreen heading has no explicit14sp size.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore exact heading and handle variants while retaining original-control chip/button selection behavior.
reviewed_findings.title: Filter-sheet heading style and drag-handle geometry differ

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Count labels and empty message11sp; app name maxLines1/end ellipsis; connection label maxLines1/end ellipsis/selectable. Card styles/elevation are independent of text.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: IntervalCount and empty message use12sp. AppActivityNativeRow Text for name and entry label does not constrain maxLines/overflow, allowing a longer row than XML.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Restore source11sp captions and line limits/overflow; preserve source row reading/selection and original range buttons.
reviewed_findings.title: Interval sheet captions and expandable row overflow differ

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Brand Heading.HomeScreen is all-caps sans-serif-smallcaps with .25em tracking and rethink_header_text size. Title16sp smallcaps with5dp extra line spacing; subtitle12sp primaryLightColorText.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: PagedStatisticsScreen uses headlineLarge for brand, titleLarge for heading and bodyMedium for subtitle, dropping source family/tracking/caps/colors and sizes. Selectable domain title behavior is preserved.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Resolve the original named style and explicit title/subtitle overrides; keep header constraints/empty-state alignment and existing selection behavior.
reviewed_findings.title: Detailed-statistics/domain headers lose original typography

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: DoH/ODoH failure TextView starts INVISIBLE, retaining measurement; its10dp margins/5dp padding differ from DNSCrypt2dp error padding. Titles have10dp padding and each layout has own field arrangement.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: Shared DnsEditorDialog uses20dp content padding/spacedBy8; DnsError emits nothing without error and has no layout-specific padding. Field restoration alone does not preserve parent/error geometry.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Model invisible versus gone error states and per-editor content insets without changing validation/callback behavior. Compare dialog window background separately from layout content.
reviewed_findings.title: DNS editor layout loses source invisible error reservation and insets

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Shared title references the concrete TextAppearance.Material3.TitleMedium resource; Smart DNS description is small_font_subheading_text=11sp with5dp padding.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: DnsFragmentHeader uses theme titleMedium (not exact direct style resource) and explicit14sp for Smart DNS description. Margins/padding are otherwise closely matched.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Resolve the explicit title style and11sp description with existing typography helper; retain native framework host and fixed IDs.
reviewed_findings.title: Smart DNS header description is 14sp instead of11sp

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: Removed-server flag24sp in40dp frame, name16sp bold/maxLines1, location13sp/maxLines1. Ping-history targets14.5sp medium, latency13sp bold medium, outcome11.5sp medium; all are single-line.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: RpnRemovalContent flag28sp with no frame and generic name/bodySmall location; PingHistoryRow resolves only numeric sizes and leaves family/weight/line limits unset.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Give each row its own complete source text/frame contract; preserve current data and callback logic and disclose large-font alternate layout separately.
reviewed_findings.title: Removed-server rows and ping-history rows lose text metrics

reviewed_findings.baseline_contract: TextAppearance.Heading.HomeScreen specifies sans-serif-smallcaps, .25em tracking, all-caps and rethink_header_text dimension.
reviewed_findings.current_source_difference: AboutContent uses SansSerif and letterSpacing7.sp; dimensionResource(...).value.sp is not a source text-style resolver and can double-apply scaled values under nonlinear font scaling.
reviewed_findings.required_before_deletion: Resolve original named TextAppearance and explicit dynamic text/click state through the existing typography resolver; keep content and source accessibility behavior.
reviewed_findings.title: About brand title uses fixed SP tracking instead of source EM/style

acceptance_policy: No new generic Material spacing/design deviations are accepted by this audit. Source-equivalence/reference cleanup and runtime validation are separate gates; a parent-reviewed source-safe deletion can proceed with runtime still explicitly unverified.

storage_schema.category_reference: Each style_contracts category entry is [node_index, attribute_indices]. node_index indexes this layout nodes; attribute_indices indexes sorted(node.attributes) keys, preserving exact original values.
